examples.en: Take a screenshot of the error, just in case support asks for it.
examples.zh: 把报错截个图，以防支持那边要看。

situation.en: I brought the adapter just in case the room has no spare.
situation.zh: 你跟同事说你带了转接头防万一。

examples.en: In case the deploy fails, the rollback script is in the same folder.
examples.zh: 要是发布失败了，回滚脚本就在同一个文件夹里。

entries.note: in case 后面接完整句子讲“万一发生”；in case of + 名词是告示体：In case of fire, ... 着火时……

situation.en: In case I'm offline, the runbook covers every step.
situation.zh: 你交代：万一你联系不上，手册里都有。

examples.en: Please book the demo room a day in advance — it fills up fast.
examples.zh: 请提前一天订演示会议室，它抢手得很。

situation.en: Let me know in advance if the date moves.
situation.zh: 你请对方日期有变提前通知你。

examples.en: In theory, the migration takes an hour; with our data, plan for three.
examples.zh: 理论上迁移要一小时，以我们的数据量，按三小时准备。

situation.en: In theory yes, but nobody has tested it on Windows.
situation.zh: 同事问功能能不能跑，你说理论上行但没测过。

examples.en: In practice, most users never change the default settings.
examples.zh: 实际上，大多数用户从不改默认设置。

situation.en: The policy sounds strict; in practice, it's flexible.
situation.zh: 你向新人解释制度其实执行得没那么死。

entries.zh: 实际上、实践中（对比理论）

examples.en: Developers in particular hate tools that force a workflow on them.
examples.zh: 尤其是开发者，最讨厌强加工作流的工具。

situation.en: I liked the second talk in particular — very practical.
situation.zh: 活动后你说你特别喜欢第二场分享。

examples.en: In spite of the outage, the team shipped on Friday.
examples.zh: 尽管出了故障，团队还是在周五发了版。

entries.note: in spite of 后面接名词或动名词；接句子要用 although。别写 in spite of that it rained。

situation.en: In spite of the small team, we kept the service running.
situation.zh: 面试里你强调人少也扛住了。

examples.en: In terms of cost, the managed service wins by a mile.
examples.zh: 就成本而言，托管服务完胜。

situation.en: In terms of risk, option B is clearly safer.
situation.zh: 你在评审里换个维度比较方案。

examples.en: The fix will take an hour — in the meantime, use the workaround from the ticket.
examples.zh: 修复要一小时，在此期间先用工单里的临时办法。

situation.en: Dinner's at seven; in the meantime, let's review the slides.
situation.zh: 你安排等待时间的利用方式。

examples.en: On average, a code review in our team takes four hours to get a first response.
examples.zh: 平均下来，我们团队的 PR 要四小时才有第一条回复。

situation.en: On average, I read about twenty pages a day.
situation.zh: 闲聊读书习惯时你说平均量。

examples.en: I am writing on behalf of the whole support team.
examples.zh: 我代表整个支持团队写这封信。

situation.en: On behalf of the team, thank you for the quick turnaround.
situation.zh: 你代表团队感谢对方的快速响应。

examples.en: With two more engineers on board, the roadmap suddenly looks doable.
examples.zh: 又来了两个工程师之后，路线图一下子显得能完成了。

entries.note: on board 还有“同意、加入进来”的意思：Is everyone on board with this plan? 大家都同意这个计划吗？

situation.en: Once design is on board, we can start building.
situation.zh: 你说等设计组加入进来就能开工。

entries.zh: （人）已加入、到位；在船上/飞机上

examples.en: Who is on duty for incidents this weekend?
examples.zh: 这周末谁值班处理故障？

situation.en: I'm on duty tonight, so my phone stays on.
situation.zh: 你告诉家人今晚你值班、电话得开着。

examples.en: The office is ten minutes away on foot.
examples.zh: 办公室步行十分钟就到。

situation.en: Let's go on foot — parking near the venue is a nightmare.
situation.zh: 你提议走过去，开车停车太折腾。

examples.en: Your call is on hold while we check the account.
examples.zh: 我们正在查账户，您的电话正在等待中。

entries.note: put something on hold 也是项目管理里的常用说法：把某事暂时搁置。

situation.en: The feature is on hold until legal approves the copy.
situation.zh: 你同步状态：功能先搁置等法务。

examples.en: Half the team is on leave during the last week of December.
examples.zh: 十二月最后一周，半个团队都在休假。

situation.en: I'll be on leave from the 20th to the 27th.
situation.zh: 你在群里同步自己的休假时间。

examples.en: The monitor I wanted is on sale this week — two hundred off.
examples.zh: 我想买的那台显示器这周在打折，便宜两百。

situation.en: Tickets are on sale from Monday.
situation.zh: 你提醒同事票周一开卖。

examples.en: Despite the outage, the launch is still on schedule.
examples.zh: 尽管出了故障，上线还是按计划进行。

situation.en: Are we on schedule for the beta?
situation.zh: 你向项目经理确认进度是否正常。

examples.en: On second thought, let's keep the old name — users know it.
examples.zh: 再想想，还是保留旧名字吧，用户都熟了。

situation.en: On second thought, I'll take the train instead.
situation.zh: 你改主意决定坐火车。

examples.en: Keep a spare laptop on standby for the demo, just in case.
examples.zh: 演示用的备用电脑保持待命状态，以防万一。

situation.en: I'm on standby this weekend if anything breaks.
situation.zh: 你告诉团队周末你待命。

examples.en: The pricing change is on the agenda for Thursday's meeting.
examples.zh: 定价调整在周四会议的议程上。

situation.en: Can we put the hiring freeze on the agenda?
situation.zh: 你想把冻结招聘加进议程。

entries.zh: 在议程上、要讨论的事项

examples.en: Sorry, I was on the phone with the vendor.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我刚才在和供应商通电话。

situation.en: She's on the phone — can she call you back?
situation.zh: 前台告诉来访者对方正在通话。

examples.en: Cloud spend is on the rise again this quarter.
examples.zh: 这个季度云支出又在涨了。

situation.en: Churn is on the rise, and nobody knows why yet.
situation.zh: 你在会上指出流失率不妙的趋势。

examples.en: He fixed the routing issue on the spot, during the call.
examples.zh: 他在通话时当场就把路由问题修了。

situation.en: They offered me the role on the spot.
situation.zh: 你说面试时对方当场就给了 offer。

examples.en: On top of the migration, we also had two incidents that week.
examples.zh: 除了迁移，那周我们还出了两次故障。

entries.note: on top of 还可以是“掌控局面”：I'm on top of it. 我搞得定。两个意思完全不同，靠语境。

situation.en: On top of everything, the CI was down.
situation.zh: 你在复盘里叠加讲述倒霉事。

entries.zh: 除此之外还（叠加坏消息时常用）

examples.en: Out of the blue, the client asked to double the scope.
examples.zh: 客户突然毫无征兆地要求把范围扩大一倍。

situation.en: He called me out of the blue after two years.
situation.zh: 你说一个两年没联系的人突然来电。

examples.en: Costs are out of control because nobody owns the cloud bill.
examples.zh: 没人管云账单，开支已经失控了。

situation.en: The thread went out of control, so I locked the comments.
situation.zh: 你说讨论串失控了，你把评论锁了。

examples.en: This screenshot is out of date — the UI changed last month.
examples.zh: 这张截图过期了，界面上个月就变了。

situation.en: Half the links in this doc are out of date.
situation.zh: 你指出文档一半链接已经失效。

examples.en: Our environments keep drifting out of sync with production.
examples.zh: 我们的环境老是和生产环境不一致。

situation.en: The subtitles are out of sync with the video.
situation.zh: 看视频时你说字幕和画面对不上。

examples.en: New joiners feel out of the loop for the first few weeks.
examples.zh: 新人在头几周会觉得自己不在信息圈里。

situation.en: Keep me in the loop on the vendor decision.
situation.zh: 你请同事有进展同步你（反义用法 in the loop）。

entries.zh: 不在信息圈内、被蒙在鼓里

examples.en: Skipping tests before a release is out of the question.
examples.zh: 发布前跳过测试是绝对不行的。

situation.en: A rewrite this quarter is out of the question.
situation.zh: 你明确否掉本季度重写的可能。

examples.en: I have been out of touch with the mobile team since the reorg.
examples.zh: 重组之后，我和移动组就没怎么联系了。

situation.en: Sorry, I've been out of touch — new baby at home.
situation.zh: 你向老同事解释最近失联的原因。

examples.en: We shipped on time three sprints in a row.
examples.zh: 我们连续三个迭代都按时交付了。

situation.en: That's the third outage in a row caused by config.
situation.zh: 你在复盘里强调这是连续第三次同类故障。

examples.en: In a sense, the outage was a good thing — it forced us to fix the alerting.
examples.zh: 从某种意义上说，这次故障是好事，它逼我们修好了告警。

situation.en: In a sense, you're both right.
situation.zh: 调解两种观点时你说某种意义上都没错。

examples.en: Let's deploy to one region first, to be on the safe side.
examples.zh: 为了稳妥起见，我们先发一个区域。

situation.en: Back it up first, just to be on the safe side.
situation.zh: 你提醒同事先备份求稳妥。

entries.zh: 为了稳妥起见、保险一点

examples.en: I used to run the deploy script often, but I'm out of practice now.
examples.zh: 我以前经常跑这个发布脚本，现在手生了。

situation.en: Sorry, my spoken English is out of practice.
situation.zh: 面试时你为口语生疏轻轻垫一句。

examples.en: I am in the middle of a deploy — can this wait twenty minutes?
examples.zh: 我正在发布中，这事能等二十分钟吗？

situation.en: She's in the middle of something; try her after lunch.
situation.zh: 你替同事挡一下：她正忙着。

examples.en: We are in the process of moving everything to the new region.
examples.zh: 我们正在把所有东西迁到新区。

situation.en: The fix is in the process of being rolled out.
situation.zh: 你向用户同步：修复正在逐步上线中。

examples.en: I will be out of town during the launch week, but reachable by phone.
examples.zh: 上线那周我不在本地，但电话能联系上。

situation.en: Our manager is out of town until Thursday.
situation.zh: 你告诉同事经理周四前不在。

examples.en: After a year of remote work, I am completely out of shape.
examples.zh: 远程办公一年，我的身体彻底不行了。

situation.en: That hike showed me how out of shape I am.
situation.zh: 爬完山你自嘲体力差。

examples.en: In a way, the rewrite was an apology to our future selves.
examples.zh: 某种程度上，这次重写是我们对未来自己的一次补偿。

situation.en: In a way, the delay helped — we caught a design flaw.
situation.zh: 你从事后角度评价一次延期。

entries.zh: 在某种程度上、某种方式上
